comment: Read from src/TachyonEntangler.cpp at tag 2.0.1, the installed version. The exponential FM attenuverters run -1.7 to 1.7 and are cubed, then scaled by 0.2, giving about 0.98 octaves per volt at the extreme; the linear FM attenuverters run -11.7 to 11.7 and are cubed, giving about 1602Hz per volt. The chaos and sync modulation attenuverters run -0.1 to 0.1, so ten volts covers the whole 0 to 1 range of the knob they add to. Exponential and linear FM are each summed only while their own jack is connected. The maker's README calls oscillator B the slave; in the code either oscillator syncs the other, and the default knob settings are what make B the synced one. The square outputs run at half the sawtooth frequency, which the README states as well.
